name: ColumnChooser
description: A popover of checkboxes that chooses which DataTable columns are shown. It renders the Popover structure and is driven by the Popover controller rather than a mechanism of its own.

id.description: Names the trigger; the panel derives its own identifier from it.

visibleColumnKeys.description: Shown columns. Null shows every column, which is where an uncontrolled chooser starts.

requiredColumnKeys.description: Columns that are always shown and cannot be cleared.

trigger.description: Trusted content replacing the default trigger label.

visibleColumnsChange.description: Reports the shown column keys in declaration order.
